evidence: The text states: 'The ZrO2 and HfO2 films were deposited by MOCVD over the temperature range 400–650 /C14 C and by ALD over the temperature range 175–350/C14 C. X-Ray diffraction analysis showed that the HfO2 films deposited by MOCVD were amorphous, whereas the ZrO2 films deposited by MOCVD were in the tetragonal phase.'
